entities.summary: A compact but tactile underground fortification experience where rock-cut passages, spiral stairs, gun positions and openings over the Alzette valley turn Luxembourg's fortress history into physical exploration.
entities.description: The Bock Casemates are surviving underground defensive galleries beneath the Bock promontory. A timed self-guided visit leads through dim rock-hewn corridors, side chambers, stairways and lookout openings rather than presenting the fortifications only from outside. The result is an active forty-five-minute encounter with Luxembourg's fortress engineering and topography.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Go inside rather than stopping at the nearby bridge viewpoints: the value is in physically moving through the rock-cut defence network, descending staircases and emerging at openings over the Grund. It is the strongest standalone fortification activity among the supplied Luxembourg bridge/square candidates.
